outcome: Risk factors for neonatal COVID-19 infection
finding: Neonatal COVID-19 infection risk was higher in vaginal deliveries, babies who were breastfed and roomed-in with their mothers, and those delivered within 7 days of their mother testing negative for COVID-19.
mod_finding: The risk of neonatal COVID-19 infection was higher in the vaginal delivery group (17.39%) compared to the caesarean group (13.16%).
